articles.summary: Contact center knowledge is often scattered across knowledge bases, spreadsheets, documents, QA systems, and even paper. Learn how AI-powered platforms can bring knowledge, agent guidance, QA, coaching, and conversation intelligence into one operational source of truth.
articles.title: Stop Sending Agents to the Knowledge Base

articles.summary: The best AI agents don't just know how to act autonomously. They recognize uncertainty, risk, emotion, and complexity and know when to escalate to a human. Learn why intelligent escalation is becoming a critical AI capability.
articles.title: The Best AI Agent Knows When to Give Up

articles.summary: Customer service AI spending is surging while overall budgets remain nearly flat. Learn why contact center leaders need stronger business cases built around measurable outcomes, visibility, and continuous AI ROI.
articles.title: The AI Budget Is Growing. So Should the Business Case.
